reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 38 original B1/B2 noun questions: checked each complete German sentence, all offered choices, grammar, unique accepted answers, bilingual hints/explanations and distinct contexts. Distinction between Desinfektion (process) and Desinfektionsmittel (substance), Dienstleister (provider) and Dienstleistung (service), Direktor/Direktorin gender forms; corrected broad Dienst gloss. Deferred misleading Diplom/Master's equivalence for human review. No inherited examples copied. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending.
